class.name: CymaticAudioCompass
class.description: DOD NOTE: CymaticAudioCompass bridges `GameplayAudioOption` (`acoustic_quality`, `ai_hearing_sensitivity_multiplier`, `CymaticMap`) and `GameplayAccessibilityOption` (`visual_sound_indicators`, `cymatic_visual_gain`, `enemy_highlight_color`, `hazard_highlight_color`, `interactable_highlight_color`). It composes `CircularGauge` and `HeatmapGrid` to visualize directional acoustic energy sectors, 2D cymatic field propagation, and nearby AI `HearingRange` alert thresholds around the controlled `GameAgent` without holding raw entity pointers across frames. Part of IdeamGames (game agents, players, rules, scoring, and match orchestration).
